§4§lMAX §lAT §lEYE §lT5§r The §9Omega§r circuits, UIV to MAX, printed on Black Dwarf Matter from Sirius B. They fill any circuit slot of their tier and are §9far cheaper§r: an Omega Mainframe costs about a fourteenth of the EU of a Planck circuit (about a thirtieth while the Planck circuit's price is raised, the default), with no Universium, Eternity or Magmatter in it.

§5§lTHE §lCHAIN§r
- Engrave an §9Empyrean Wafer§r once more: Forcicium lens,§9 18 L molten Black Dwarf Matter§r and 100 L Hyperdense Stellar Mixture, 60 s at UMV → §9Omega Wafer§r → 8 Omega Chips.
- Boards from Empyrean Circuit Boards (Assembler: Hexanite, Shirabon, Dimensionally Transcendent Residue).
- Processors in the Circuit Assembler; the rest on the Assembly Line (Research Station research), with Stellar SMDs.
- Every §9Omega Mainframe§r is built around one Empyrean Mainframe.
- §9Two fluids§r again: engrave in a §9multiblock§r laser engraver (GT's Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver, or any engraver multi with two input hatches), not the single block.

§5§lTHEY §lCOUNT §lAS§r Processor = UIV, Assembly = UMV, Supercomputer = UXV, §9Mainframe = MAX§r. In a §9computer rack§r the Mainframe gives 380 computation, slightly better than a Planck circuit.

[note]The pack's MAX machines and parts still need their own late materials: Eternity and Magmatter (Eye T7), and Universium and MHDCSM, which come with Eye T10 (coming later). Omega only removes the circuit wall.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold an Omega Processor and an Omega Mainframe.
